name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.4-beta+2

- TV (Flutter): anime from your extensions, through your phone or PC
  - Pairing now also hands over how to reach the phone/PC (link port + token; the address is where the pairing came from). TV keeps up to 4 (TvExt, KV plus_ftv_sources); Settings → Accounts lists them (Forget).
  - The TV connects to the device's link (/tv, same protocol as the web TV app) and asks 'ext servers' for an episode; videos and subtitles come through the device's proxy. Works for Java and JS extensions alike.
  - Sources page: 'Extension · <name>' servers first for anime, next to the Stremio addons, as they arrive. Next episode keeps the same server.
  - Anime no Stremio addon has now plays from the extension (anilist: ids, progress to AniList); the details button shows which device is used.
  - The phone starts its link when the app opens (once paired) so it can answer while AnymeX+ is open; the PC already does.
- TV (Flutter): change your AniList list from the TV
  - Details: the list button opens an editor: status, episodes (−/+, All watched, None), score out of 10, Save, Remove from list (press twice). MAL and Simkl follow through AniList's update, as on the phone.
  - Hold OK on an episode (or long-press with the pointer): anime → 'Watched up to E5' / 'Mark not watched' (progress goes to just before); series → that episode watched / not watched in Stremio.
  - Status follows progress (last episode completes, first moves Planning to Watching); tested in TvListRules.
